verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe adaptive interruption handling, which lets the agent respond naturally when users speak mid-response and acoustically separates intentional barge-ins from backchanneling. The audio-based TurnDetector supports turn management by predicting whether the user has more to say. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that agent speech is halted on barge-in, evidence that conversation context or transcript is updated (e.g. truncated to what was actually spoken), detail on how the turn is recovered after an interruption, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
